g.text: Cie Fermière des chemins de fer tun…

svg.text: 20 firms in 8 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 129 firms, 322 interlocks, 9 components (largest 109). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 38 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
